# Vendored scripts

`qrcode-generator-2.0.4.mjs` is `dist/qrcode.mjs` of the npm package
[`qrcode-generator`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator) 2.0.4
(Kazuhiko Arase, MIT, source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator),
copied unchanged. It is served from this site because the pages allow
scripts from their own origin only. The auditor dashboard loads it only to
draw the QR code of a transaction that links a public-network account.
